conviction_note: Two plausible positives the release can ADD (a forecast revision the company itself flagged as 'under review' in August with Q1 already at 76% of the FY operating plan and 144% of the FY net plan, and a buyback under a mid-term plan that promises 75-100% total payout after rejecting an 800-yen bid) against two negatives (Q2 carries three months of TOB-defence adviser costs, and 1.45m margin-long shares, about 13% of shares outstanding, bought on the TOB spike and now underwater), so p_up 55 on a 3.0% scale gives +0.3 while the findings sum to +0.5; the gap is the margin overhang, which I weight more in the reaction than its own finding size.
bar: No sell-side coverage (kabuyoho consensus shows '--', https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=6897). The only sourced bar is the company plan, unchanged since 2026-04-14: FY2027/2 sales 9,600m, OP 100m, ordinary 75m, NP 45m (Q1 決算短信 https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260713/140120260713591887.pdf). No H1 plan is published. 四季報 forecast unreachable. print_vs_bar_pct is my read of the H1 operating line against a pro-rata/seasonal reading of that plan in which H1 is normally loss-making; it rests on an unsourced street bar, so every finding is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position >=0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-09-29 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). Margin (kabutan, https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=6897, read 2026-10-14): 売り残 0, 買い残 1,449.3k shares on 10/09 (1,446.6k 10/02, 1,506.0k 09/25, 1,499.6k 09/18, 1,520.9k 09/11) against 10,906,300 shares issued, i.e. ~13% of shares on margin long and ~40+ sessions of median turnover; the name is 信用買いのみ (no margin short possible), so 信用倍率 is undefined/infinite and there is no squeeze fuel. No options, no skew. Run-up -18.46% over 20 sessions as the TOB premium deflates (spot 539 vs ~392 before the 2026-06-22 TOB proposal and ~690 in July-August).

findings.finding: The full-year forecast is formally under review and stale: Q1 (Mar-May) OP 76m vs FY plan 100m, ordinary 90m vs 75m (120%), net 65m vs 45m (144%), plus a 52m investment-securities gain booked in August whose notice says the FY forecast 'is being scrutinised including other factors and will be disclosed promptly if a revision is needed' -- in a company whose H1 has been loss-making three years running (-228m, -350m, -399m OP), so an upward revision of at least ordinary/net profit at this print is more likely than not.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 on 2026-07-13 (15:00), the print that already showed 120% ordinary progress, moved +1.61% prev close to next close (685 -> 696). Pre-TOB prints moved 0 to -4.8% (2025-07-11 -4.83% on a widened Q1 loss); the 2026-04-10 downward revision moved -0.74%. A revision-up has no precedent in the 3y tape.
findings.why_not_priced: The Q1 progress is public since July, so the quarter itself is not the finding; what is not in the price is the forecast DECISION, which the company explicitly deferred in August. The stock has fallen 18% in 20 sessions on the TOB unwind, not on earnings; if a revision were expected and priced you would expect the post-withdrawal drift to have stalled into the date, and it has not (565 on 10-01 to 527 on 10-13). No analyst covers it, so no number on the street anticipates the revision.
findings.independence: Q1 短信 numbers (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260713/140120260713591887.pdf) and H1 history from kabutan's finance page (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=6897) are separate documents; the August gain notice is the only one that says the forecast is under review. Net-profit part of the revision rests partly on one-off gains (land sale in Q1, securities sale in August), which is why this is sized small.

findings.finding: The Q2 period (Jun-Aug) carries the full cost of defending against Japanet's 800-yen TOB proposal: the company retained Plutus Consulting as FA and valuation agent, Mori Hamada & Matsumoto as legal adviser and QuestHub Advisory, and its special committee met 18 times between 2026-06-03 and 2026-08-31; on a company planning 100m of full-year OP, these fees can wipe out the Q2 operating line if booked in SG&A.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior defence cost in this name's record; no comparable line has surprised before.
findings.why_not_priced: No amount has been disclosed and no special-loss notice was filed before the print (kabutan disclosure list shows nothing after 2026-09-04), so the size and the line it lands on (SG&A vs 特別損失) appear for the first time in the 短信. A one-off below or around OP with no path to the guide, so sized at a fraction.
findings.independence: none -- the cost magnitude is my inference from the adviser roster in the opposition statement; it may be booked as a special loss and leave OP untouched.

findings.finding: The new mid-term plan (2026-08-31), published the same day the board rejected the 800-yen bid, commits to progressive dividends on payout/DOE, 'flexible' buybacks and 75-100% total payout with 1.2-2.0bn yen of returns over five years (21-34% of the 5.85bn market cap), while Buffalo president Hiroyuki Maki has built an 11.72% stake stating his purpose as maximising total shareholder return; a first buyback announced with the H1 results is a live possibility that nothing in the price assigns.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No buyback or dividend change at the last two H1 prints (2025-10-10, 2024-10-11: dividend held at 3 yen interim, 13 yen annual); the plan's own dividend chart shows 13 yen for the current year, so a dividend increase is not signalled.
findings.why_not_priced: The plan is public, but the stock has fallen from ~690 to ~536 since it was published, i.e. the market priced the bid's withdrawal and not the returns policy; if a buyback were expected the price would not be drifting to new post-TOB lows into the date. Sized as probability (~1 in 4-5) times a large move, not as a confirmed event.
findings.independence: Maki's 変更報告書 with his stated holding purpose (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6897&b=n202609080277, 2026-09-08) points the same way from a different document; cash went DOWN 198m in Q1 and the plan funds returns from operating CF, which cuts against an early buyback.

findings.finding: 1.45m shares (~13% of shares outstanding, ~40 sessions of median turnover) sit on margin long, built on the June-September TOB spikes at ~650-700 yen and now ~20% underwater, in a name where margin shorting is not allowed, so any rally on good news meets break-even sellers and any disappointment meets leveraged forced selling.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The balance barely moved (1,520.9k on 09-11 to 1,449.3k on 10-09) while the price fell from 643 to 526, i.e. these holders have not been selling into the decline; no prior print with this overhang exists.
findings.why_not_priced: The balance is public, so its level is in the price; what is not is the reaction asymmetry it creates at the print, which the baseline cannot see because its margin_ratio is null. If the overhang had been cleared, the 買い残 would have fallen with the price; it has not.
findings.independence: Daily volume history (Yahoo chart https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/6897.T?range=6mo&interval=1d): 1.5m shares traded on 2026-06-24 at 730 and 2.0m on 2026-09-03 at ~693, consistent with the margin cohort's entry prices.

outside_window.finding: Margin longs opened on the 2026-06-22/24 TOB spike reach the six-month 制度信用 repayment deadline in late December 2026, a dated supply overhang.

release_time_source: Not announced for this print; last year's H1 短信 and the FY2026/2 短信 were stamped 14:00 on TDnet (https://kabutan.jp/disclosures/pdf/20251010/140120251010571367/, https://kabutan.jp/disclosures/pdf/20260414/140120260414503312/), Q1/Q3 at 15:00 -- either way before the 15:30 close, so the window starts at the sealed spot.
bar_hierarchy: Revision: likely, company said in Aug the FY forecast is 'under review' with Q1 already past the FY ordinary and net plans; direction of OP uncertain because of TOB-defence costs. Returns: possible first buyback under the Aug-31 75-100% total-payout plan; dividend shown unchanged at 13 yen. New-year guide: n/a (H1). Quarter vs own 進捗率: H1 OP has been negative three years running (-228/-350/-399m) while this year's Q1 alone is +76m, so any positive H1 is far ahead of own history, but that progress is public since July.

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly positive, in line with the baseline's priced_lean +0.92 (all of it run-up mean reversion) and against the 20-day drift itself; the strongest positive the release could carry is a buyback under the new payout policy, which I looked for and found no pre-signal of, and the strongest negative is the underwater margin cohort, which the baseline cannot see.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: rule 1 (negatives on public series pull p_up toward 50) would only move p_up from below 50, and mine is already 55; rule 2 (look for the positive) was already done -- two positives and two negatives, buyback and revision searched for explicitly
